tone.target: bright hot-rodded Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.profile: bright hot-rodded Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.summary: A tight, bright Marshall crunch tone achieved using the UK 45 amp model, paired with a moderate OD boost and a classic British cab simulation.
corrections: reduce gain to hard rock crunch

rig.name: Judas Priest - Living After Midnight - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain rhythm playing and eliminate hum.
Provide the necessary light overdrive boost and bite for tight palm-muted crunch.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD or OD 9 could also work, but Green OD is often associated with classic British rock tones.

blocks.purpose: Used as a subtle grit layer to enhance the crunch without adding fuzz character.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is generally too aggressive for this specific 'crunch' requirement, but it provides excellent mid-range bite if Green OD isn't enough. Keep it off or set very low.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the bright, punchy character of a Marshall JCM800/Plexi style amp.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary upper-mid punch.
Slightly boost the upper-mids and treble to achieve the required 'bright upper-mid attack' while keeping the tone focused.
Placeholder for potential wah use; kept inactive as the target tone is dry and punchy.
blocks.gap: None (Module included to meet minimum block count, but deactivated).

blocks.purpose: Minimal delay for subtle depth; kept inactive to maintain a dry rhythm feel.
blocks.gap: None (Module included to meet minimum block count, but deactivated).

blocks.purpose: Add a minimal amount of natural room ambience to prevent the tone from sounding too sterile, while remaining dry.
blocks.gap: The target specified 'dry rhythm feel,' so this reverb is kept very low (15% mix) and short decay time.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for increased mid-range punch and cabinet realism.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper-mids and overall vintage Marshall character.
